title: Link a domain to your website
blurb: Choose which website or funnel shows on your domain.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Domains & URL Redirects
steps.body: Click **Domains & URL Redirects** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Open the domain
steps.body: Find your verified domain in the list and open its settings.

steps.title: Pick the site
steps.body: Choose Website or Funnel, then pick which one.

steps.title: Home page
steps.body: Pick the page that shows when someone types just your domain.

steps.title: Error page
steps.body: Set a 404 page for broken links, ideally one with a link back home.

steps.title: Wait for the padlock
steps.body: Save. The secure padlock (SSL) is usually ready within a few minutes.
